title: Southern Breeze
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Southern Breeze”, a luxury 5-bed, 5.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Rooftop Terrace & Golf Cart. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS • 5 Bedrooms • 4.5 Bathrooms • Sleeps 18 • Large Heated Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $80 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) • Rooftop Terrace with Gulf Views • 1 Bedroom Carriage House with Kitchen • 3 Stories & 4,340 Square Feet • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Inlet Beach Access Down Winston Lane • Private Drive • Parking for 8 Vehicles SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 18) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 4) • Guest Suite: King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity and Shower/Tub Combination • Bunk Room: Twin over Twin Bunk SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 8) • Primary Suite (Sleeps 2): King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Large Tile/Glass Walk-in Shower, Large Walk-in Closet and Shared Balcony • Guest Suite (Sleeps 2): King Bed with shared Jack and Jill Bathroom with Single Vanity and Shower/Tub Combination • Guest Suite (Sleeps 2): King Bed with shared Jack and Jill Bathroom with Single Vanity and Shower/Tub Combination + Shared Balcony • Bunk Nook (Sleeps 2): Twin Over Twin Bunks Carriage House (Sleeps 6) • Guest Suite (Sleeps 2): King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity and Tile Glass Shower • Bunk Nook (Sleeps 2) with Twin Over Twin Bunks • Queen Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) DESCRIPTION Nestled in the heart of Inlet Beach, ‘Southern Breeze’ is a sanctuary where Southern charm meets coastal elegance. Just steps from the sugar-white sands and a leisurely stroll to Rosemary Beach, this exquisite 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home is a symphony of comfort, sophistication, and timeless beauty. Framed by lush landscaping and the vibrant blooms of camellias, this retreat welcomes you with the promise of serenity and splendor. Inside, the main living area is a haven of relaxation, where two plush sofas encircle a cozy fireplace, inviting laughter and quiet moments alike. The gourmet kitchen, with its large island, sparkling appliances, and thoughtful touches like a wine fridge and ice maker, becomes the heart of the home, perfect for sharing meals and creating memories. The first-floor king suite offers a restful escape, while the screened porch whispers of mornings spent savoring coffee amidst the gentle sea breeze. Also on the first floor is a bunk room with a twin over twin bunk. Outside, the private pool glistens, embraced by the scent of blooming flowers and the warmth of the sun. Ascend to the second floor, where the luxurious primary suite becomes your personal retreat, complete with a fireplace and access to a sweeping wrap-around balcony. Here, time slows as you take in views that lead to a third-floor observation deck, where the Gulf shimmers in the distance. Two additional bedrooms, including a charming bunk nook, offer spaces filled with comfort and charm. The detached carriage house extends a gracious welcome to guests, with its own living area, full kitchen, and balcony overlooking the pool. It is a retreat within a retreat, offering privacy while keeping loved ones close. Beyond the home’s walls, the meticulously designed outdoor spaces invite gatherings under the stars, with a summer kitchen, a heated pool, and an outdoor shower nestled in the embrace of a private, fenced backyard. Every corner of ‘Southern Breeze’ is touched by elegance, every moment enhanced by its graceful beauty. From the lush landscaping to the blooming camellias, from the timeless interiors to the peaceful surroundings, this is more than a house—it is a place where memories are made and dreams linger long after the journey home. LAYOUT FIRST FLOOR: • Main Living Area with two large sofas and fireplace • Kitchen with large island that seats six o Appliances: Fridge, Dishwasher, Oven, Gas Stove Top, Wine Fridge, Ice Maker and Convection Microwave • Dining Room seats 6 • First Floor King Guest Suite and Ensuite Bath • Bunk Room with Twin over Twin Bed • Laundry Room with front load washer and dryer • Half Bath off Laundry Room & Office/Media Room • Access to Pool Deck • Access to Screened Porch Seating Area SECOND FLOOR: • Primary Suite & Ensuite Bath *Fireplace is currently not for guest use* • King Guest Suite with shared Jack and Jill Bathroom • King Guest Suite with shared Jack and Jill Bathroom • Bunk Nook • Large Wrap Around Balcony Leads to third floor Observation Deck CARRIAGE HOUSE: • Living Area with Queen Sleeper Sofa • Full Kitchen with bar seating for three o Appliances: Fridge, Gas Range and Oven, Microwave & Dishwasher • Bunk Nook • Balcony overlooking the pool OUTDOOR AREA: • Private Heated Pool • Summer Kitchen with Gas Grill & Fridge • Outdoor Shower • Private Fenced Backyard CONVENIENT LOCATION: • Camp Helen State Park - 2.5 miles • Alys Beach - 1.5 miles • Rosemary Beach - 0.5 miles • 30Avenue Shopping and Dining - 0.8 miles • The Big Chill - 3.5 miles
